trends.name: Iran Escalation & Oil Price Surge
trends.summary: Trump signals imminent additional military strikes against Iran, triggering Brent crude to surge past $110/barrel (+7% intraday, +70% from Dec 2025 lows). Iranian regime shows no signs of collapse and signals war will continue. Global equities plunging amid geopolitical uncertainty and energy supply fears.

trends.name: Tech Sector Selloff & Valuation Reset
trends.summary: European and Asian tech sectors experiencing worst day since early February amid broader market selloff. China's START50 index down 3% with Korea Exchange triggering circuit breakers on 5% KOSPI 200 futures decline. Microsoft AI reset noted as creating rare bargains despite sector weakness.

trends.name: Stock-Oil Divergence at 20-Year High
trends.summary: S&P 500 and crude oil moving in opposite directions in 76% of recent sessions (38 of last 50 trading days)—highest correlation breakdown in at least 20 years. Signals unprecedented portfolio hedging challenges and traditional risk-off playbook breakdown.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure Storage Bottleneck
trends.summary: Storage capacity emerging as critical constraint for AI inference scaling beyond training. Western Digital and Seagate positioned to benefit as HAMR technology matures into supply-critical story. CoreWeave infrastructure play highlighted as beneficiary.

trends.name: Chinese AI & Cloud Computing Weakness
trends.summary: Huawei's cloud computing revenue declined in 2025 as Chinese AI solutions significantly lag U.S. rivals. START50 tech index decline reflects broader structural challenges in China's AI competitive positioning versus U.S. dominance.

trends.name: Nike & Consumer Discretionary Collapse
trends.summary: Nike experiencing second-largest 25-year loss, signaling severe consumer discretionary demand deterioration. Broader weakness in apparel/consumer goods reflected in equity sell-offs amid macroeconomic stress.

trends.name: Energy Supply Chain Disruptions
trends.summary: U.S. gasoline pipeline damaged in Georgia; Gulf states considering new pipelines to bypass Strait of Hormuz vulnerability. Iran conflict triggering supply chain hedging and infrastructure diversification accelerating amid geopolitical risk.

trends.name: EV Demand Paradox Amid Engine Pivot
trends.summary: EV demand receiving short-term boost from Iran war premium on oil prices, even as major auto manufacturers pivot back to combustion engines. Market divergence reflects conflicting signals on long-term powertrain strategy and fuel price assumptions.

trends.name: February Payroll Data & Labor Market Softening
trends.summary: February payrolls expected at 60k with 4.4% unemployment—signaling significant labor market deceleration. Challenger job cuts report coming, adding to concerns about employment trend heading into rate decision season. Early Good Friday data critical for Fed policy outlook.

trends.name: Dividend Cuts vs. Hikes Inflection Point
trends.summary: March sees mixed dividend signals with 6 raises but 1 at 10% and 2 cuts reported. FRA downgraded on NAV erosion if distributions not cut; signals income investors facing yield sustainability pressure amid macro uncertainty.

trends.name: Aerospace & Defense Positioning Shift
trends.summary: China tests 7-ton cargo drone with 1,850-mile range for reconnaissance ops. U.S. Secretary Noem signals new Latin American security doctrine. Geopolitical escalation driving defense spending reallocation and aerospace modernization priorities.

trends.name: Potential M&A Wave: SpaceX IPO & Amazon-Globalstar
trends.summary: SpaceX reportedly making key strategic move toward jumbo IPO after private market plateau. Amazon weighing Globalstar acquisition (+15% surge), signaling satellite/space infrastructure consolidation wave. Signals PE/VC capital rotation toward hard assets and government-backed tech.
